spec: Rule cards for libretro cores whose save behaviour deviates from RetroArch's standard savefile_directory rule. This is world knowledge under DESIGN.md's boundary rule: each card states WHICH live config governs the core and what its values mean — the current value is always read from the machine, never from here. Cards are keyed by the core's canonical short name (the .so basename without _libretro.so, matching libretro-core-info filenames); 'identifiers' lists every name the card matches, including the display library_name the core binary reports. Facts live here; interpretation lives in code — a rule that does not fit this schema gets code plus a card referencing it, the schema does not grow a DSL.

provenance.source: flycast_libretro.so option strings ('Per-Game VMUs', mode descriptions); live observation of <system_directory>/dc on RetroDECK 0.10.9b — vmu_save_{A1,B1,C1,D1}.bin + dc_nvmem.bin present, A1 written by play. Slot-2 VMUs (A2..D2) appear only when a port's slot 2 is configured as VMU.
